name: Sara
source:
A cool and ambitious girl with an elite personality. She is wary of the protagonist, who is from the city, seeing him as an outsider, and treats him harshly.
Despite her strong-willed personality, she becomes submissive when dominated, revealing her masochistic tendencies.
